Handshake help

This guide holds Handshake’s own help, gathered on 19 August 2026 from the publisher’s own listing, so every article arrived with its title, its section and its body.

Handshake writes for three audiences in one estate: students and graduates looking for work, employers recruiting them, and the university careers staff who run it. All three are here under their own headings, so a student can skip the recruiter material without it being lost. The community forum is not here, since those posts are other users answering each other rather than the publisher’s own words.

Access & Manage Your Account

Canceling a Request to Join the Wrong Company

During the onboarding process, you may have accidentally requested the wrong company profile. If this happens, you can easily cancel the request.

If you’ve logged out, log back in. On the landing page, click the blue hyperlinked text Cancel request next to the question “Made this request accidentally?”

After canceling the request, you’ll be redirected to the page where you can choose to either create a new company profile or join an existing one.

  • To request to join an existing company, refer to the section Join or create your company profile in How to Create an Employer Account on Handshake.
  • If a profile for your company does not yet exist or if you want to create a new profile for a specific branch or location, refer to How to Create a New Company Profile.
  • If you’re unable to create a new company profile, contact Support.

Create a Student Account (if you already have an Employer Account)

Employers who already have an employer account are welcome to sign up for a student account as well.

Before you sign up

  • Use your .edu email address if possible. If you still have access to your .edu email, use it when signing up. This can make it easier to connect with your school.
  • No access to your .edu email? Contact your school’s career services office to confirm if you have an alumni account. If not, ask whether they prefer you to use a personal email address instead of a corporate one. Note: The school may create an account for you using either your .edu or personal email address.

Create or access your student account

Select your current status to follow the correct steps for accessing or creating your student account:

  • Your school set up your account
  • Your school did not set up your account- you need to create one
Your school set up your account

If your school created an initial account using your .edu or personal email, you will receive an email invitation from Handshake at handshake@notifications.joinhandshake.com with the subject line “You have been invited to Handshake.”

  1. Open the email from Handshake and click Confirm My Account.

  2. On the Set your password screen, enter your new password in the new password field, confirm it in the confirm new password field, then click Confirm Account.

  3. Once your account is confirmed, enter your account email address in the Email field, then click Continue with email.

  4. If your school uses SSO, a Welcome to Handshake screen will appear prompting you to continue with your school credentials. Choose one of the following:

  • Click Continue to [School] SSO to log in using your school credentials.
  • Click Log in another way to log in with a password or one-time code instead.
  1. If you selected Log in another way, or if your school does not use SSO, choose one of the following:
  • Click Send one-time code to receive a temporary login code by email.
  • Enter your password in the Enter password field, then click Continue with password.
  1. Complete The Student Onboarding Experience.

Your school did not set up your account — you need to create one

  1. Navigate to app.joinhandshake.com.

Note: If you are currently logged in to an employer account, log out before continuing. To sign out, select your name in the upper-right corner of the page and choose Sign out from the dropdown menu.

  1. On the Make career moves screen, enter your email address in the Email address field, then click Next.

  2. On the Find your school screen, confirm the school that is pre-selected if you entered a .edu email address, or select your school from the dropdown if you entered a personal email address.

  • If you cannot find your school or are not an active student, click Continue without a school at the bottom of the screen.
  • If your school has specific instructions for creating an account, they will appear in a gray box below the dropdown.

  1. Click Next.

  2. On the Create a password screen, enter your new password in the New password field and confirm it in the Confirm new password field.

  • Your password must be at least 8 characters and include a combination of letters, numbers, and special characters.

  1. Click Create account.

  2. On the Let’s get the basics screen, complete the following fields:

  • First name
  • Last name
  • Major
  • Education pursuing
  • Graduation month
  • Graduation year
  • Any additional information requested by your school

  1. When finished, click Finish setup.

  2. Check your inbox for an email from Handshake and click Confirm email to verify your email address.

  3. After confirming your email, you will be redirected to complete The Student Onboarding Experience.

Switching between accounts

You can only switch between employer and student accounts if both are registered with the same email address. Learn more about Switching User Views.

Log in to Handshake as an Employer

You can log in to Handshake using your email address and either your password or a one-time code sent to your email.

If you haven’t created an account yet, refer to How to Create an Employer Account on Handshake.

How do I log in to my Handshake account?

  • Go to app.joinhandshake.com. Choose one of the following options to continue:
  • Click Continue with Google to sign in using your Google account.
  • Enter your account email address in the Email field, then click Continue with email.
  1. On the next screen, choose one of the following:
  • Click Send one-time code to receive a temporary login code by email.
  • Enter your password and click the Log in button. Note: If you enter an incorrect email and password combination, a red banner will appear with the message: “That email and password combination doesn’t match. Try again or use a one-time code instead.” You can dismiss the banner by clicking the X, then try again or use the one-time code option.

How do I log in with a one-time code?

If you choose Send one-time code, Handshake sends a six-digit code to your inbox. The email comes from Handshake at handshake@m.joinhandshake.com with the subject line “Here’s your one time password.”

To finish signing in:

  1. Open the email from Handshake.

  2. Copy the six-digit code, then paste it into the One-time code field on the Enter one-time code screen.

  3. Click the Verify button.

  4. Once verified, you will be logged in to your account automatically.

Note: If you need to use a different email address, click Edit next to your email on the Enter one-time code screen. If you did not receive the email, click Resend code to request a new one. Each one-time code can only be used once and expires after 30 minutes to help protect your account.

Managing Company Connections in Handshake

If you’re changing employers, need to represent more than one company, or want to register a new company under the same email address, follow the steps below to make sure your account is set up correctly.

If you’re changing employers

If you’ve used Handshake before with a different employer, whether you can reuse your account depends on the email address you used when registering.

If you signed up with a company email address

If your Handshake account was created using your previous company’s corporate email (for example, jane@oldcompany.com) and that domain is exclusive to that organization, you will need to create a new Handshake account using your new company email (for example, jane@abc.com).

If you signed up with a personal email address

If your existing Handshake account was created with a personal email (for example, jane@gmail.com), you can continue using the same account. You will just need to leave your previous company and request to join your new one.

To leave your previous company, refer to Leaving a Company in Handshake.

After requesting to join your new company profile, a request will be sent to the company’s owner or admin for approval.

If the company owner is inactive or no one responds, contact our Support team.

Tip: Whenever possible, use the email domain associated with your company when joining a company in Handshake. This helps verify your connection to the organization and accelerate the verification process.

If you need to create a second company profile under the same email

Handshake does not allow multiple company profiles to be created under the same email address.

If you need to register a second company, you will need to complete the registration process using the company email address associated with that organization.

Notes:

  • Each company profile must be registered separately with a unique company domain.
  • A single email address cannot be connected to more than one company profile at a time. If your organization has multiple divisions you want to represent in Handshake, you can add divisions to your existing company profile. Read more about How to Add Divisions to Your Company.

If you need to create or represent multiple companies

Each Handshake user account can only be connected to one company profile at a time.

If you need to register a new company, you will need to complete the registration process using the email domain associated with that company. Each company profile must be registered separately with a unique company domain.

If you recruit for or manage roles on behalf of multiple companies, you will need to create a separate Handshake account for each one, using the corresponding company email address for that organization.

If your organization has multiple divisions you want to represent in Handshake, you can add divisions to your existing company profile instead of creating separate company profiles.

If you represent multiple clients as a third-party recruiter, refer to If you’re a third-party recruiter.

If you’re a third-party recruiter

Third-party recruiters should either connect with the company they represent or create a company profile on Handshake if that company is not yet registered.

Pending Approval to Join Company

If you’re pending approval to join your company profile on Handshake, this article explains who approves your request, what to expect, and what to do if no one is available to approve you.

If you haven’t created an employer account yet, refer to How to Create an Employer Account on Handshake.

Who approves my request?

When you request to join a company profile, your request must be approved by an existing Owner or Admin on the profile.

In Handshake, this approval step is required if:

  • Auto-approval is disabled, or
  • Your email domain doesn’t match the one associated with your company’s profile. Even if you’re the head of the organization, you won’t be automatically approved unless you’re the first person to create the company profile.

If you’re unsure who can approve your request or believe no one is currently managing the company profile, contact our Support team.

Waiting for approval

If the owner of your company profile has configured the profile settings to manually approve users who request to join, the message “Your request to join the [COMPANY] is under review. Your request to join [COMPANY] has been sent. We’ll send you an email as soon as you’re approved” is displayed after you sign up.

You will also receive an email confirmation indicating that your request to connect has been submitted successfully. The owner of your company profile will be notified and can review your request.

The email will read:

From: Handshake <handshake@m.joinhandshake.com

Subject: “Your access request to [COMPANY].”

Body:

“You’ve requested access to [COMPANY].

Hi [NAME]

You have successfully requested access to [COMPANY] on Handshake. An alert has been sent to the schools you requested to connect with, as well as staff members at your company.

We’ll send you an email as soon as they approve you!”

Approval timeline

Typically, requests are reviewed and approved within 1–5 business days. If your request isn’t approved within that time frame, contact Support.

Canceling your request

If you no longer want to join the company or accidentally submitted a request to the wrong one, you can cancel it at any time before approval. Read more about Canceling a Request to Join the Wrong Company.

Switching User Views (Access & Manage Your Account)

Handshake users can create multiple account types using the same email address, such as Career Services, Employer, and Student accounts.

If you have more than one account type linked to the same email address, you can switch between them without logging out.

To switch between account views, each account must be created using the same email address.

Each linked account must also have a confirmed email address before you can switch between account views.

You may need to switch account views if:

  • you are in the wrong account view
  • you cannot access certain features, such as teammate management
  • you need to complete an action that is only available to a specific account type

Switching users from a career services account

  • Click your name in the upper right corner of the Handshake screen.
  • Select Switch Users from the dropdown menu.
  • All connected accounts will be listed. Select Switch to Students Account or Switch to Employers Account, depending on which account you would like to access.

Switching users from an employer account

  • Click your name in the upper-right corner of the Handshake screen.
  • Select Switch Users from the dropdown menu.
  • All connected accounts will be listed. Select Switch to Career Services Account or Switch to Student Account, depending on which account you want to access.

Switching users from a student account

  1. Click your account icon in the upper-right corner of the Handshake screen. This may appear as your first initial or a small photo if you have a profile picture.

  2. Select Switch Users from the dropdown menu.

  3. All connected accounts will be listed. Select Switch to Career Services Account or Switch to Employers Account, depending on which account you would like to access.

If an expected account does not appear

If an expected account type does not appear in the list, or Switch Users is unavailable, confirm that each account was created with the same email address.

If your accounts use different email addresses or different email domains, Handshake treats them as separate accounts and they will not be linked for switching.

Errors when switching accounts

If you receive an error message while switching accounts, review the sections below.

Email verification required

If you receive a message indicating that you need to verify your email address, you must verify the email associated with your Handshake account.

Click the verification link in the message to receive a verification email. Then open the email and follow the instructions to complete verification.

Common reasons you may receive this message include:

  • Support manually added your account upon request
  • Support assisted with a sync and your account was not fully verified Note: Each account created in Handshake must be verified before use.
Email confirmation required

If you receive a message stating that you have not confirmed your email address, you will need to confirm the email associated with your account.

Click the link in the message to resend the confirmation email, then follow the instructions provided.

If you are not receiving the confirmation email, refer to Troubleshooting a Missing Confirmation Email.

Troubleshooting Missing Confirmation Email (Access & Manage Your Account)

The confirmation email sent during account creation is important for security and for accessing your Handshake account. If you haven’t received it, use the steps below to troubleshoot and resend the email.

Troubleshooting steps

Step 1: Check your email address
  • Make sure the email you used during sign-up is spelled correctly.
  • Look in your junk or spam folder.
  • Search your inbox for “Email Confirmation.”
  • If you encounter the message “Couldn’t find that account” when trying to log in, your email may have been entered incorrectly during sign up. In that case, you will need to create a new account.

Step 2: Review your email client settings

Sometimes filters or security settings route emails away from your main inbox.

Tip: Review any rules, filters, or spam settings that may prevent delivery.

For client specific guidance, choose your provider below:

  • Gmail
  • Outlook
  • Yahoo

Step 3: Add Handshake to your contacts and resend the email

  • Add handshake@m.joinhandshake.com to your contacts.
  • Log in to Handshake. You will be redirected to a page indicating your email hasn’t been confirmed.
  • Click the Resend confirmation email button on the page to resend the confirmation email. The message should arrive right away, but it can take up to 10 minutes.

Step 4: Contact your IT department

If you still haven’t received the email, reach out to your company or institution’s IT team. Ask them to confirm that Handshake messages aren’t being blocked and request that they add our domain to their allow list.

Note: Some organizations use a 24 hour quarantine period for new vendors or rely on antivirus tools or firewalls that may delay or block email delivery.

Step 5: Wait and resend

After IT has reviewed the issue, log in to Handshake and resend your confirmation email. If your institution or organization uses a 24 hour quarantine period, wait the full day before trying again.

If you’ve completed the steps above and still cannot receive the email, contact Support.

What if I accidentally signed up for the wrong account type?

If you registered for a student account but intended to create an employer account, you can still create an employer account.

Can I convert my student account to an employer account?

No. Handshake does not support converting a student account to an employer account or an employer account to a student account.

To access employer features, you must create a separate employer account, even if you plan to keep your student account active.

How do I create an employer account using the same email as my student account?

  1. Log out of your student account completely.
  • Remaining logged in will result in the error: “You do not have permission to do that. Please contact the Handshake team or your local administrator.”
  • If your browser signs you back in automatically, open an incognito or private browsing window before continuing.
  • If you selected the wrong account type during registration and can’t return to the previous page, complete the student account registration first. After the account is created, log out.
  1. Create your employer account using the same email address.
  • Follow the instructions outlined in How to Create an Employer Account Linked to Your Student Account.

Can I keep my student account?

Yes. You can keep your student account if you want to explore or view the features available to students. Keeping both accounts does not affect your student account or your employer account.

After both accounts are created and confirmed with the same email address, you can switch between them using the Switch Users feature.

Can I delete my student account?

Yes. If you no longer need your student account, contact Support and request deletion. Include the email address associated with the account and confirmation that you understand deletion is permanent.

Troubleshooting login and permission issues

Why am I getting a “You do not have permission to do that” error?

This error usually means you’re still signed in to the wrong account type, or your browser or school’s single sign-on system is redirecting you to your student account.

  • Log out of Handshake completely.
  • Close and reopen your browser.
  • Try again in an incognito or private browsing window.
  • Return to the Employer registration page.
Why do I keep landing on my student dashboard?

This typically happens when you sign in using a one-time code or your school’s single sign-on, which routes you to your existing student account instead of your employer account.

Employer accounts use a Handshake email address and password, not school single sign-on credentials.

Sign in through the Handshake login page using your employer email address and password.

Why can’t I access my employer account in Handshake?

There are various reasons you may not be able to log in and access your Handshake account.

The following outlines common issues and their solutions when attempting to access your account.

You may be entering the wrong password

If you receieve the message “That email and password combination doesn’t match. Try again or use a one-time code instead,” it means the password entered does not match the email on file.

  • Confirm the email address is entered correctly, with no typos, extra spaces, or an outdated email.
  • Double-check your password and confirm Caps Lock or Num Lock isn’t unintentionally enabled, since they can alter what you type.
  • Click the eye icon next to the password field to reveal the characters as you type. This helps confirm there are no typos, extra spaces, or autofill errors before submitting.
  • If you use a browser-based or extension-based password manager, disable it temporarily. These tools may auto-fill outdated or incorrect credentials and interfere with login attempts if they haven’t been updated.
  • If the error continues, use the “Send one-time code” option shown in the error message to log in. Once signed in, reset your password from your account settings. For step-by-step instructions, refer to Reset Password for an Employer Account. You changed your email address

If your new email address doesn’t match your company’s domain, your access will remain pending until the company profile Owner or Admin reapproves you for security reasons.

If you are the only user connected to your company profile, contact Support.

Your account is not confirmed

If you log in and encounter a message stating “Verify your email! Check your inbox,” it means your email address has not yet been confirmed.

Verification emails are usually sent immediately but may take up to 10 minutes to arrive. The link remains valid for 12 hours. If more than 12 hours have passed, you will need to resend the email to generate a new link.

If you aren’t receiving the confirmation email, refer to Troubleshooting Missing Confirmation Email.

Your account is not validated or requires additional verification

Account not validated

If the message “We’re reviewing your new account” appears when logging in, it indicates that your account has not yet been validated. As part of Handshake’s Trust and Safety process, all new accounts are manually reviewed and validated upon creation.

Account requires additional verification

If you log in and encounter a message stating “Your account is under review” or “Your account is temporarily suspended,” it indicates that additional information is required.

Learn more about our Employer Validation.

You are not connected to a company profile

You are logged in, and your email is confirmed, but you are still being prompted to create or join a company.

This usually means your initial connection request wasn’t submitted successfully, or you haven’t created a company profile yet. If you are trying to join an existing company profile, submit your request again to ensure it completes successfully.

Learn How to Create an Employer Account on Handshake.

Your request is still pending approval

When you log in, if your status is “Your request to join the company is under review”, it means your request was submitted successfully. However, you won’t have full access to Handshake until the company profile owner reviews and approves it.

Learn how to expedite approval in Pending Approval to Join Company.

Your account is deactivated

If you log in and receive a message stating that your account has been deactivated, it may be due to one of the following reasons:

  1. The owner or admin of the company profile manually deactivated your account.

  2. You have not logged into your account for an extended period.

To reactivate your account, contact the owner of the company profile. The owner’s contact details are displayed on the login screen.

If you can’t access your account or have other issues, contact Support.

Why Can’t I Log in with My Password? (Access & Manage Your Account)

In some cases, you may be asked to sign in using a one-time code instead of your password. This helps keep your account secure and only takes a minute to complete.

What the login page shows

When this happens, the login page will show:

  • A message stating you can’t log in with this password right now and that you should use a one-time code to sign in instead.
  • An option to send a one-time code to your email address.
  • The password field, which will no longer let you continue with password. This is a normal part of keeping your account secure. Your account has not been locked, and you have not lost access to Handshake.

How to sign in when this happens

  • On the login screen, confirm the email address shown is correct. If it’s not, select Edit to update it.
  • Click Send one-time code.
  • Check your email for the code and enter it to complete sign-in.

Why doesn’t my colleague see the same things that I do?

While your colleagues are connected to the same company profile, their access may differ from yours due to various factors, including user roles, permissions, and system-related issues.

User roles and permissions

Each user in Handshake is assigned a role, and permissions vary with each role. These roles are typically assigned based on the tasks you perform. In Handshake, permissions determine a user’s control, including what information they can access and what tasks they can perform. To view your permissions, refer to A Guide to Employer Role Types in Handshake.

System-related issues

In some cases, users may be unable to view certain pages or page contents due to system-related issues. These may include:

  • Temporary errors or bugs in the platform that can restrict access to specific features or data.
  • Outdated browsers or versions may cause pages to load incorrectly.
    • Learn more about Handshake Supported Browsers (for Employers).
  • Intermittent connectivity or network restrictions may block access to content.
  • Stored data in the browser can sometimes prevent page content from loading properly. If you experience issues accessing content, try clearing your browser cache, switching browsers, or contacting support for further assistance.

Add or Remove Teammates

Connecting a Teammate after Rejecting Their Access Request

If you accidentally rejected a teammate’s request to join your company profile, you won’t be able to reapprove that same request.

The teammate can still be connected to your company by following the steps below, which vary based on your account type.

Basic employers

If your company has a Basic account, the teammate will need to request to join your company profile again.

  1. When the teammate logs in to Handshake, they will be prompted to create a new company or request to join an existing one.

  2. They should search for your company profile and submit a new join request.

  3. You will receive the new request.

Ready to approve it? Follow the steps in How to Approve Teammates at a Company.

On-campus employers and premium partners

If your company has an on-campus, Plus, Pro, or TES account, you can manually connect the teammate to your company profile.

Not sure how to manually add a teammate? Check out How to Manually Add Teammates to your Company’s Profile.

How to Approve Teammates at a Company

Handshake provides multiple options for approving new teammates to join your company profile.

Options by account type

The options available to you depend on your company’s account type:

Basic employers

Basic employers cannot manually approve teammates unless the teammate’s email address does not match your company’s verified domain.

Approval behavior depends on the type of email domain:

  • Verified company domain (e.g., @yourcompany.com)
    • Users signing up with a verified domain are automatically approved and connected to your company profile.
    • The owner will receive an in-app notification:
    • “A new teammate has joined the company.”
    • You can update this in your Default Notification Preferences (Employers).
  • Shared domains
    • If a user joins the wrong company (e.g., due to a shared domain across multiple organizations), you can report the user to our Support team.
  • Generic or unverified domains (e.g., @gmail.com, @outlook.com)
    • Auto-approval does not apply.
    • The owner must manually approve teammate requests.
On-campus employers and Premium partners

These accounts have full control over teammate approvals. You can:

  • Manually approve teammate requests
  • Enable auto-approval for teammates using your company’s verified domain To set up auto-approval, refer to How to Auto Approve Staff Members.

Manually approve teammates

  1. Click on the user icon in the white toolbar at the top of the page, slightly to the left of your name.

Note: This is an action that can only be performed by the Owner or Admin of the company profile.

  1. A list of teammates awaiting approval to join the company profile will be displayed.

  2. Click the three hash marks to the far right of the name of the teammate you want to approve, then select View Request.

  • If the teammate’s email domain does not match your company’s domain, the error message “PLEASE NOTE: We could not verify that this user’s email domain matches this company. Please do your due diligence in confirming this user actually belongs at this company and is not a fraudulent user before approving. You should not approve this person unless you are sure they legitimately work for this company.” will display in a red banner at the top of the page.

  1. Click the green button Approve to approve and complete the request.

  2. Upon approval, the user will automatically receive an email notification. However, if the user’s request is rejected, they will not receive a notification.

  • If you accidentally reject someone who needs to be approved, refer to Connecting a Teammate after Rejecting Their Access Request.

How to Auto Approve Staff Members

Automatically approving staff members allows any user with a valid email address that matches your company’s domain to be approved as soon as they request access.

This feature is available only to on-campus employers, as well as Plus, Pro, Essential, and TES customers. For more information, please check out this resource!

Owners of Basic accounts cannot automatically approve staff members. To automatically approve staff members, you must upgrade to an eligible paid plan.

Prefer to approve each request manually? Learn how in How to Approve Teammates at a Company.

Auto-approval requirements

  • Your company must be the sole account on Handshake associated with its email domain.
  • If multiple companies share the same email domain, auto-approval is not available.
  • New company profiles created using an email domain not already associated with another company will have auto-approval enabled by default.
  • If your company’s email domain changes and you want to retain auto-approval, contact our Support team so we can update your company group.

Who can enable this feature?

Only the Owner or an Admin of the company profile can enable auto-approve.

Set up auto-approval

  1. Click on your name in the upper-right corner of any page, then select Company settings from the dropdown.

  2. From the menu on the left, click Global Settings.

  3. In the New teammate access section, check the box for Auto-approve new users who sign up with a valid email that matches your company’s domain, then click the black button Submit.

  • With this feature enabled, any user who signs up for Handshake with a valid email address that matches your company’s domain will be automatically approved to connect with your company profile when they request access.

How to Create an External Contact

External contacts on Handshake are teammates or other individuals from your company that represent your organization and can serve as the focal point of information concerning an activity, such as a job or event.

  1. To begin, click Contacts from the left navigation bar, then click the blue button Add Contact in the upper-right corner of the Contacts page.

  2. Fill out the fields on the page. Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required.

  • Email address*
  • First name*
  • Last name
  • Location*
  • Title
  • Phone
  • Cell phone
  • Fax
  • Description
  1. Once complete, click the green button Create Contact in the lower-right corner of the page.
  • Once a contact is created, they will be added to your company’s contacts list on Handshake. Note: This does not create a Handshake account for teammates without a user account. It simply stores their contact information in the system, allowing them to receive emails, including attachments related to the activity.

How to Deactivate or Reinstate Teammate Accounts

On Handshake, you can deactivate (remove) teammates who are no longer with your company and reactivate (reinstate) their accounts if they return.

Before you begin: Who can deactivate or reactivate a teammate?

Only Owners and Admins of a company profile can deactivate or reactivate a teammate.

This feature is available to:

  • Plus, Pro Essentials, and Enterprise (formerly TES) customers
  • On-campus employers
    • You must be designated as an on-campus employer in your profile settings to deactivate or reactivate teammates. This designation is enabled by the owner of the company profile. Learn more about Identifying as an On-Campus Employer on Handshake. Important: Owners of Basic accounts cannot deactivate or reinstate teammates. If you are on a Basic plan, you will not see the “Deactivate user” option. To manage teammate access, you must upgrade to an eligible plan. To learn more about upgrading your employer account, please review this resource.

For on-campus employers with multiple accounts

If you have both:

  • An employer account
  • A Career Services account You must switch to your employer account to reactivate or deactivate teammates from your company profile. You must also be an Owner on the employer account to complete this action. If you do not see the option to deactivate a teammate, confirm that you are in the correct account and have the appropriate role.

Deactivate a teammate

  1. Click on your name in the upper-right corner of any page, then select Teammates from the dropdown.

  2. On the Teammates page, locate the user you want to remove.

  3. Click the three dot menu to the right of their name, then select Deactivate user from the dropdown.

  4. In the pop-up window, click the red Confirm button to deactivate the user. Once the user is deactivated:

  • The user’s role will be reset to Representative. If the user is already a Representative, their role will remain unchanged.
  • The user will no longer be visible on your Teammates page and will lose access to their account.

Reactivate (reinstate) a teammate

  1. On the Teammates page, use the Status filter on the left and select Deactivated.

  2. Locate the teammate you want to reactivate.

  3. Click the three dot menu to the right of their name, then select Activate account from the dropdown.

  • Once activated, the user regains access to the account.

How to Invite Staff Members to Join Handshake

Invite colleagues to create an account and join your company profile on Handshake using a unique invite link.

Note: Invite links are intended for colleagues who do not already have a Handshake account.

If you are an on-campus employer or an Essentials or TES customer and prefer to manually add a teammate, refer to How to Manually Add Teammates to your Company’s Profile.

Inviting staff members

  1. Click your name in the upper-right corner of the page, then select Teammates from the dropdown.

  2. Click the gray Copy Invite Link button in the upper-right corner of the page.

  3. Copy and share the invite link.

  • On-campus, Basic, Plus, and Pro employers
  • In the pop-up modal, copy the invite link and share it with your colleague(s).
  • Essentials and TES employers
  • In the pop-up modal, select the appropriate role for the user(s) from the dropdown, then copy the invite link and share it with your colleague(s). The invitation link is valid for 48 hours. After it expires, a new link must be generated and sent.

When your colleague uses the link, they will be automatically connected to your company with the assigned role.

If your colleague cannot use the invitation link

If your colleague clicks the invitation link and encounters a permission error or cannot complete signup, they may already have a Handshake account.

For on-campus employers adding a former or current student

If you are an on-campus employer and your colleague already has a student account, the invitation link cannot be used.

Instead, manually add them using the same email address associated with their student account. This creates an employer profile linked to their existing account and allows them to switch between student and employer views.

For step-by-step instructions, refer to How to Manually Add Teammates to your Company’s Profile.

If they already have an employer account

Connected to another company

  • If they do not intend to remain with that company, they should disconnect from that company profile and then request to join the company they intend to join.
  • To stay connected to their current company while joining a new one, they must create a separate employer account using an email address with the domain of the company they want to join. Pending approval at another company

If they have a pending request to join another company, they must cancel that request first. Once canceled, they can submit a new request to join their intended company.

Not connected to any company

If they have an employer account but are not connected to a company profile, they should log in and request to join the appropriate company.

How to Manually Add Teammates to your Company’s Profile

You can manually add a teammate to your company profile whether or not they already have a Handshake account.

Note: Handshake allows each user to be connected to only one company profile per email address.

This feature is only available to on-campus employers and Premium partners. For more information, please check out this resource!

If you’re a Basic employer, you can invite teammates by sending a unique invitation link. Learn more about How to Invite Staff Members to Join Handshake.

Topics:

  • Check if your colleague already has a Handshake account
    • No account exists
    • Account exists
  • Manually adding teammate without an account
  • Manually adding a teammate with an account

Check if your colleague already has a Handshake account

To avoid errors during the invite process, check whether your colleague already has a Handshake account before adding them.

  1. Open an incognito window to avoid being automatically logged in, then go to app.joinhandshake.com.

  2. Enter your colleague’s email address in the field labeled ‘Email address’, then click the Next button.

If no account exists
  • If no account exists, a message appears that says: Oops, we don’t know you yet. If that happens, which option feels right for you?
  • Proceed to Manually adding a teammate without an account.

If an account exists

  • If an account exists, you will be prompted to log in, which means your colleague already has a Handshake account.
  • Proceed to Manually adding a teammate with an account.

Manually adding teammate without an account

If your colleague does not have an account yet, you can manually add and invite them to join your company profile.

  1. Click your name in the upper-right corner the page, then select Teammates from the dropdown.

  2. Click the gray Add Teammate Manually button in the upper-right corner of the page.

  3. Complete the fields on the New Teammate form. Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. Your colleague can edit this information later.

Required fields

  • Email address

  • First name

  • Last name

  • Role Optional fields

  • Title

  • Visible on Company Profile (checkbox)

  • Bio

  • Mobile phone number

  • Office phone number

  • Message (this message is included in the invitation email)

  1. Click the green Create User button in the lower-right corner of the page.

  2. A confirmation banner will appear at the top of the page: “User added. An email has been sent to the user with a link to let them set their password and login.”

  3. The user will receive an email invitation to set their password and access their account.

The email will read:

Subject: “You have been invited to Handshake”

From: Handshake handshake@notifications.joinhandshake.com

Body:

Hello [NAME], You have been added as a staff member at [COMPANY NAME] by [INVITEE]. An initial account has been set up for you. Your username is EMAIL.

Please confirm your account by clicking this link: [LINK].

Thank you,

The Handshake Team”

  1. When your teammate clicks the link, they will be redirected to set and confirm their password. After that, they can log in.

Manually adding a teammate with an account

If your colleague already has a Handshake account, they may need to resolve their current status before they can join your company profile:

  • Not connected to any company: They can request to join your company, or you can add them from the Teammates page.
  • Note: They must confirm their email address before they can be added to a company profile.
  • Pending approval at another company: They must cancel that pending request first.
  • Connected to the wrong company: They must disconnect from that company before joining yours.
Add the existing user

Once their status is resolved:

  • Click your name in the upper-right corner of the page, then select Teammates from the dropdown.
  • In the Add existing user by email… field at the top of the page, enter your colleague’s Handshake email address.
  • Click the gray Add User button.
  • The user will be added to your company profile.
If you cannot add them using “Add existing user by email…”

If the system does not find your colleague when you enter their email in the Add existing user by email…field, they may not have an employer account yet, even if they already have a Handshake student or alumni account.

In this case, use the Add Teammate Manually feature and enter the email address the teammate uses for Handshake. For complete steps, refer to the section Manually add a teammate without an account.

This will create an employer account that is linked to their existing account.

API

EDU API: Foreign keys as Endpoints in Different Tables

Sometimes endpoints will exist in other tables as foreign keys. Foreign keys exist in tables outside of their original table.

Use this article as a reference for what different endpoints exist as foreign keys in different tables.

Topics:

  • Students
  • Employers
  • Jobs
  • Postings
  • Career Fair Sessions
  • Career Fair
  • Event
  • Industry
  • Survey
  • Other IDs

STUDENTS

The students table will have endpoints on student data (i.e. first name, last name, major etc.)

Look for the student_id foreign key in other tables to tie in student data. The student id endpoint exists in the following tables:

  • Applications
  • Appointments
  • Career fair attendance
  • Event attendance
  • Experiences
  • First destination responses
  • Interview schedule slots
  • Student interests
  • Student labels
  • Student skills

EMPLOYERS

The employers table has base line data on employers (i.e. description.)

Look for the employer_id foreign key in other tables to tie in employer data. The employer id endpoint exists in the following tables:

  • Applications
  • Career Fair Employer Engagement
  • Collections (as a list) - the key is plural (e.g. employer_ids)
  • Contacts
  • Employer Labels
  • Event Employer Engagement
  • Events (found as host_id or owner_id if the host or owner type is Employer)
  • Interview Schedules
  • Jobs
  • Meetings

JOBS

The jobs table will have endpoints on job data (i.e. title, description, etc.)

Look for the job_id foreign key in other tables to tie in job data. The job id endpoint exists in the following tables:

  • Applications
  • Collections (as a list) - the key is plural (e.g. job_ids)
  • Interview Schedules (as a list) - the key is plural (e.g. job_ids)
  • Job Labels
  • Job Locations
  • Job Role Group
  • Job Student Qualifications
  • Postings

POSTINGS

The postings table will have endpoints on job posting data (i.e. title, description, etc.)

Look for the posting_id foreign key in other tables to tie in job data. The posting id endpoint exists in the following tables:

  • Job Student Qualifications

CAREER FAIR SESSIONS

The Career Fair Sessions table will have endpoints on fair session data (i.e. start time, etc.)

Look for the career_fair_sessions_id foreign key in other tables to tie in session data. The session id endpoint exists in the following tables:

  • Career Fair Attendance
  • Meetings

CAREER FAIR

The Career Fairs table will have endpoints on fair data (i.e. title, description, etc.)

Look for the career_fair_id foreign key in other tables to tie in fair data. The fair id endpoint exists in the following tables:

  • Career Fair Sessions
  • Career Fair Employer Engagement
  • Collections (as a list) - the key is plural (e.g. career_fair_ids)

EVENT

The Events table will have endpoints on event data (i.e. title, description, etc.)

Look for the event_id foreign key in other tables to tie in fair data. The event id endpoint exists in the following tables:

  • Collections (as a list) - the key is plural (e.g. event_ids)
  • Event Attendance
  • Event Employer Engagement
  • Event Labels

INDUSTRY

The Industry table will have endpoints on industry data (i.e. title, e.g.)

Look for the industry_id foreign key in other tables to tie in fair data. The industry id endpoint exists in the following tables:

  • Employers

SURVEY

The Survey table will have endpoints on surveys data (i.e. title, e.g.)

Look for the survey_id foreign key in other tables to tie in fair data. The survey id endpoint exists in the following tables:

  • Events
  • Career Fairs
  • Survey Responses

Other IDs

  • Host_ID and Owner_ID in the Events endpoint refers to the employer or school ID depending on the Host_type or Owner_type
  • First_destination_survey_id is located in the First destination response endpoint
  • Interview_slots_id is located in the Interview Schedule endpoint
  • job_role_group_id - found in job role groups endpoint
  • Question_id in survey responses

Getting Started with EDU API

Handshake’s EDU API is a scalable, secure, and developer-friendly solution for data management and automation. With features like read-only data retrieval, institution-scoped access, versioning, and delta fetching, the API ensures efficiency and reliability.

Topics:

  • How to setup your account
  • Supported Entities and Endpoints
  • Query Parameters
  • Requests
  • Responses
    • Successful Response
    • Error Response

How to setup your account

  • Open the Developer Portal: edu-api.joinhandshake.com:444.
  • Select Sign in. The sign in form will appear:
  • Use the Username and Password provided by the Handshake Support team via 1Password. Select Sign in. You will be directed to the following API Catalog page:
  • Go to Applications in the tabs section. Select Register an Application.
  • Fill out the Register an Application form. Only the Application Name field is required. Please keep the Application Status radio button Enabled.
  • Select Register. You will be redirected to the Applications screen:
  • Now go back to the API Catalog tab. Select EDU API v1.
  • On the EDU API v1 page select Subscribe.
  • The following pop-up will appear, and your application will be selected in the dropdown. Add a message for the request, which will be sent to the Handshake Support team.
  • Click on Subscribe. The following message will appear:
  • Submit a ticket to our Support team letting them know your EDU API Subscription needs to be approved. The team will review your request in 48 hours or less.
  • You have access to the status of your request in the Subscriptions tab. After your request is approved, your API status will be set to Enabled.
  • Select EDU API v1. Your API key is generated on the following screen. Anytime there’s an API request, you will need to use this key. If you regenerate the API key, please reach out to the Handshake Technical Support Team to have the new key enabled. The key must be enabled by Support before it can be used. You’re all set! You can now start using the API. Read below for details on supported endpoints, example requests, and responses.
