Background Check FAQs

Some Handshake AI projects require a standard background check during onboarding. This FAQ explains why background checks are required, what information is collected, and how your data is handled.

For a step-by-step overview of the process, refer to Understanding the Background Check Process.

Why is Handshake AI doing background checks now?

Handshake AI is growing, and we’re partnering with organizations that require additional screening. Implementing background checks for specific projects helps us continue to offer high-quality, specialized opportunities to our fellow community.

What information do I need to provide, and why?

During project-specific onboarding, you’ll be asked to provide basic identifying details, including your Social Security Number (SSN). The check may also look into your:

  • Criminal history: Checking for past convictions.
  • Identity verification: Making sure the person is who they say they are.
  • Employment history: Confirming previous jobs and experience.
  • Education verification: Ensuring degrees or certifications are accurate. This information is used exclusively to verify your identity and ensure the background check is performed accurately. This is a standard requirement for professional verification services to distinguish between individuals with similar names and to ensure the results are correct.

What does Handshake AI do with my data? Who has access to it?

Your sensitive personal data, such as your SSN, is submitted through a secure interface provided by our specialized verification partner.

  • Limited Access: Handshake Support and project staff do not have access to view your SSN and criminal records submitted through this process. Our partner, Yardstik, is able to view this information as needed while processing reports or in the event of a dispute. For further information about this, refer to Yardstik Security & Compliance.
  • Purpose-Driven: The data is used solely to process the background check for your eligibility in the project.

How long does it take, and what happens while I wait?

Once you submit your information, the check typically takes up to 7 days to process. This process may be shorter or longer depending on specific circumstances.

  • During the Wait: The check runs automatically in the background. You don’t need to take any further action. You may still work on the project in the meantime.
  • When It Completes: When you pass the check, you will be cleared to proceed with your onboarding. There is no separate “Pass” notification; the background check step in your dashboard will simply mark itself as complete, allowing you to move forward.

What happens if there is an adverse finding in my background check?

Handshake determines the background check criteria based on our standards and our customers’ requirements. The background check decision is made by Handshake, and if your background check contains results that are inconsistent with our requirements, you will receive a pre-adverse action notice through Yardstik. You’re able to directly dispute the results with Yardstik. Learn more about this in How can I dispute the results of my report?

The background check decision is made by Handshake, and if your results are inconsistent with our

Is my information kept secure / shared with anyone outside what’s necessary?

Your information is only shared with our trusted third-party verification vendor, Yardstik, for the purpose of completing the check. We use industry-standard encryption and security protocols to ensure that your data remains protected throughout the entire submission and processing window

What if I want to decline my background check?

If you choose to decline the background check, you won’t be able to participate in specific projects. A background check is mandatory for certain projects.

My background check expired — can I get a new one?

The time to complete a background check doesn’t expire. Reports stay in a created state on Yardstik until submitted.

What if I already completed a background check for another company?

You still must complete the background check for Handshake AI. We’re unable to access or rely on other companies’ processes.

What if I already completed a background check for Handshake AI?

Fellows are expected to complete only one background check for Handshake AI. The only time we may request a secondary background check is if there are inconsistencies found in your account or the information you provided. If you have received a second background check from Handshake AI in error, please reach out to your project lead.

What if I believe there are inaccuracies in my background check?

If you have questions about the completion status of your background check or believe any information in your report is inaccurate, log in to profile.yardstik.com or email their support team at support@yardstik.com.

I would like to delete the data from my background check.

Please reach out to Yardstik directly for data deletion requests. You can email their support team at support@yardstik.com.

Will you sell my background check data?

Handshake AI will never sell your background check data. It’s only accessible to our Trust & Safety team, who review results to determine your eligibility to participate in a project.

I’m not a U.S. fellow — do I still have to do a background check?

Yes. All fellows participating in these projects must complete a background check.

If you’re located outside the U.S., you’ll receive an email from our background check partner, Checkr, with instructions on how to complete the process. You will not complete your background check through Yardstik, which is our background check partner for U.S.-based fellows.

Official emails from Checkr are sent from support@checkr.com.

From application to first project: your complete Handshake AI Fellowship journey

We’re excited to have you join the Handshake AI Fellowship! This program connects talented fellows with meaningful projects through our AI Lab partners. Below is an overview of what to expect after applying, including the steps that take you from application to getting started on your first project.

Topics covered in this guide include:

  • Project matching and invitations
  • Project onboarding
  • Payout setup through Stripe These steps apply after a fellow has created a Handshake AI account and completed the required profile setup.

1. Application submitted

Once you sign up, complete your profile, and submit your application, your Handshake AI profile becomes eligible for matching with open projects that align with your skills, experience, and qualifications.

Our team reviews applications and matches fellows to projects based on the needs of our AI Lab partners. Since projects are launched on a rolling basis according to partner demand, there is no fixed timeline for receiving a project invitation.

To learn more about what happens after you apply, refer to Next Steps After Applying to the Handshake AI Fellowship.

2. Project match & interest email

If your profile matches an available project, you’ll receive an email invitation from our team asking if you’d like to express interest in participating.

Project invitations typically include:

  • A project description
  • Estimated project length
  • Expected time commitments (if applicable)
  • Compensation details and participation requirements
  • Other important project information Invitation details may vary depending on the project. Some projects may also require additional information from you, such as a slide deck, portfolio, or other work samples. These requirements will be outlined either in the invitation email or within the project workspace in Handshake AI.

Any materials you submit are securely maintained by Handshake and may be used by the AI Labs team to evaluate your qualifications before moving forward.

3. Decision & selection

After you submit your form of interest, there will be a short waiting period while interested candidates are reviewed for the project. If you’re selected to join the project, you’ll receive another email confirming your acceptance.

4. Project Onboarding

Before you can begin working on a project and earning compensation, you’ll need to complete that project’s onboarding requirements.

Please note that onboarding steps may vary by project. All required onboarding tasks will be listed within the project workspace in Handshake AI.

What fellows need to do:

  • Open the assigned project in Handshake AI
  • Review all onboarding requirements carefully
  • Complete each required step before starting project tasks

5. Training & Getting Started

Once onboarding is complete, you may begin training to help prepare you for the work ahead.

Training may include:

  • Detailed project information
  • Expectations, deliverables, and responsibilities
  • Best practices and project guidelines
  • Information about where project work takes place and how time tracking works When approved to start tasking, you can begin working on your assigned project and contributing to project deliverables based on the project requirements and timelines.

To learn more about what to expect and how to set yourself up for success, refer to Getting Started on a Project.

6. Set Up Your Payout Method

Handshake AI uses Stripe to process fellow payouts.

After completing your first task on a project, you’ll be prompted to set up your payout information through Stripe. You can also add or update your payout method at any time through the Payments tab in your Handshake AI dashboard.

Important notes:

  • A valid payout method must be configured in Stripe before payments can be processed
  • Make sure your payout information is accurate and kept up to date to avoid payment delays or issues We’re here to support you at every step as you begin your journey with Handshake AI. If you have questions along the way, don’t hesitate to reach out to our support team—we’re always happy to help.

Handshake AI Fellowship: Getting started & staying safe

Welcome to the Handshake AI Fellowship! This guide covers everything you need to get started, from applying and setting up your account to recognizing scams and knowing what to do if something feels off.

Part 1: How to apply and onboard

Handshake provides you with access to all of the tools and sites related to the Handshake AI Fellowship. The only times you’ll provide sensitive information are through:

  • Persona (identity verification during account creation)
  • TaxBandits (tax information)
  • Stripe (payment processing) Here is a quick guide on what we ask for and related resource links for more information. You can apply through our program site: joinhandshake.com
Create or log into your account
  • Existing users: log in with your Handshake credentials
  • New users: create a student account and enter your school (or email if your school isn’t partnered or you’ve graduated)
    • New accounts not created by a school require phone number verification. Learn more about Phone Number Verification for Handshake AI.
    • Steps to create an account with and without a school affiliation available in Creating an Account and Logging In to Handshake.
Complete your profile
  • Fill in required details
  • Upload your resume
  • Steps with screenshots available in Apply to the Handshake AI Fellowship.
Confirm your email, then verify your identity
  • Confirm your email: check your inbox for a confirmation email from “handshake@m.joinhandshake.com”, then follow the link to confirm your account.
    • Troubleshooting Missing Confirmation Email
  • Verify your identity: you’ll be asked to upload a government-issued ID (e.g., driver’s license, passport) through our partner, Persona. Follow the secure, on-screen verification process
    • Troubleshooting Persona Identity Verification
Complete onboarding

Once approved, you’ll land in your Handshake AI dashboard and can start working and earning if you’ve been invited to a project. If you haven’t yet been invited to a project, you can still take the steps below while you wait for a match.

Learn more about what to expect in Your Handshake AI journey: from application to first project.

From here, the order steps are completed in may vary, but will always include:

  • set up tax details (via TaxBandit)
    • completed via a popup from your dashboard
  • setup payout method (via Stripe)
    • Steps available in How to Set Up Stripe. Important: If you’re being prompted to share any sensitive personal information through a site or method other than the steps described, do not enter any information or proceed further - contact Support to verify!

More details available in Handshake AI Payments Processing.

Part 2: How to spot fraud and scams

Scammers sometimes target students & fellows. Knowing what to look for can protect you.

What scammers want
  • Personal data (SSN, bank info, passwords)
  • Access to your account (via fake login links)
  • Money (gift cards, crypto, wire transfers) Important: Handshake and its partners will never ask for sensitive information via text, in-app messages, email, phone, social media or WhatsApp.
Fake Job or Project Offers on Handshake: Someone may contact you with an “opportunity” outside the Handshake platform

Red flags:

  • Asking to move off Handshake to apply or provide PII (via email, WhatsApp, phone, Google Form)
  • Does not ask for your credentials or verify your identity
  • Requests for personal or financial information outside the Handshake onboarding process
  • Poor grammar or overly casual tone
Impersonation on Handshake: Scammers may create accounts or profiles pretending to be official organizations (Handshake, schools, employers)

Red flags:

  • Urgent messages (“Act now or lose access”)
  • Suspicious profiles or accounts
  • Messages claiming to be “Handshake Support”
  • “Student” accounts offering support
Impersonation off Handshake: Scammers may pretend to be a Handshake employee reaching out with invitations or followups

Red flags:

  • Misspelled or fake domains (e.g., joinhandhsake.com, joinhandshake-careers.com)
  • Generic, valid email addresses (e.g. handshake.helixprojectlead@gmail.com, handshakeprojectlead@gmail.com)
  • Requests to complete a Google Form as part of validation or verification (e.g. provide either your Handshake Code or your Handshake Password)
  • Urgent requests to avoid delays or disqualification

Part 3: What legitimate Handshake communication looks like

Handshake will only contact you via:

  • texts if you opted in to receiving SMS updates.

  • email addresses ending with joinhandshake.com. When in doubt, always double-check the sender’s email domain. Handshake does not send any official communication through:

  • WhatsApp

  • Other messaging apps or services If there are ever any changes to Handshake’s contact methods, we’ll update this article and other official, relevant resources. A full list of official email domains, platforms Handshake has an employer account on, tips, and more are available in How to Recognize Legitimate vs. Fraudulent Communications.

Handshake uses Google Forms for certain workflows, however, Handshake will never:

  • Ask for sensitive information via message, email, or Google Form
  • Send account-related requests through in-app messages or feed posts

Part 4: What to do if something feels off

If you receive a suspicious message

  • Don’t click any links or share personal information.
  • Don’t respond to the message.
  • Contact Support to confirm email validity or report suspicious activity. If you’ve already shared personal information

Take these steps right away:

  • Contact your bank or credit card company immediately to protect your account and dispute any charges.
  • Secure your accounts: change passwords on any accounts that may have been compromised.
  • File a report with the FTC (Federal Trade Commission) at reportfraud.ftc.gov — the FTC handles complaints about scams and identity theft.
  • Report to your local police. Authorities can investigate regardless of where the scammer is located.
  • Contact Handshake to report what has happened. These steps and more are available in Safety: Protecting Your Personal Information.

Quick reference: red flags vs. legitimate communications

Red flag - pause and verify!

Legitimate Handshake communication

Messages from “Handshake Support” in-app

Responses via email, ending in joinhandshake.com

Misspelled or generic email domains

Email addresses ending joinhandshake.com only

Requests for SSN, bank info, or passwords

Never asks for sensitive info outside onboarding

Threatening language

Clear, professional tone, which can have a near-term deadline to sign up

Suspicious or shortened links

Links clearly from joinhandshake.com

Text messages or WhatsApp from “Handshake” or “Handshake AI”

Handshake and Handshake AI does not send SMS or WhatsApp

Offers with unusually high pay for little work

Legitimate project listings with clear details

If something feels off — pause before clicking, sharing, or replying. When in doubt, contact Support to verify.

Identity Verification: How It Works

This guide explains how to complete identity verification using Persona, our trusted identity verification provider. Identity verification is a one-time requirement that must be completed before you begin your first project.

Although verification is only required after you’ve been invited to your first project, in some instances you can complete it as soon as you’ve finished your application. Completing verification early can help prevent delays if you’re later allocated to a project that requires it.

Some projects may also require a background check. To learn more, refer to How Background Checks Work with Yardstik & Persona.

Note: The Persona interface may change over time as the product is updated, so the screens in this guide may differ slightly from what you come across. However, the overall verification process remains the same.

Verification Steps

1. Start identity verification

If you’ve been invited to a project, open the project from your dashboard.

If you haven’t been invited to a project yet but would like to complete verification early, click the circle next to Verify your identity on your onboarding checklist.

2. Begin the verification process

Click Begin verifying to start your identity verification.

3. Select your verification country

Choose the country that issued the government ID you’ll use for verification.

4. Choose and upload your ID

Select one of the following government-issued photo IDs:

  • Driver’s license
  • State ID
  • Passport
  • Permanent Resident Card
5. Continue on a device with a camera

The remaining steps require a device with a camera, such as a smartphone or tablet. Scan the QR code using your device to continue.

Before you continue:

  • Have your chosen photo ID ready.
  • Complete the verification in a well-lit area.
  • Remove hats, sunglasses, or anything that obscures your face.
  • Allow a few minutes to complete the process without interruption.
6. Take a photo of your ID

Tap the camera button to begin capturing photos of your ID.

When prompted, allow Persona to access your device’s camera. Camera access is required to complete verification.

7. Capture your ID

Follow the on-screen instructions to take clear photos of the front and back of your ID (if applicable).

8. Take a selfie

After your ID has been captured, follow the prompts to take photos of your face for identity verification.

9. Finish verification

Once your identity has been successfully verified, you’ll see a confirmation on both your mobile device and in the browser where you started the process.

Click Done to return to Handshake. From there, you can continue setting up your payout method or proceed to your project.

If your having issues with your verification, check out Troubleshooting Persona identity verification.

Introduction to the Handshake AI program

The Handshake AI program connects current students, recent graduates, and professionals with flexible, project-based opportunities to help train and improve large language models (LLMs). Fellows use their human judgment and subject-matter expertise to strengthen the performance of models developed by leading AI labs.

What is the Handshake AI Fellowship?

Handshake AI enables students and graduates to apply human judgment and expertise to improve large language models (LLMs) developed by frontier AI labs. The work you can find on Handshake AI is flexible and project-based, allowing you to earn (and use your expertise) while you’re in school or working.

Project work through Handshake AI may include:

  • Reviewing and editing AI-generated content
  • Annotating datasets
  • Suggesting improvements to model outputs
  • Helping shape how AI tools perform in real-world scenarios Participants are matched to projects based on their background, experience, and project demand. Assignments are made according to project needs rather than personal preference.

Handshake AI projects do not involve screening or evaluating candidates on the Handshake career platform. Fellows support the improvement of AI models in specific subject areas while Handshake continues to explore broader applications of AI internally.

Who is the Handshake AI Fellowship for?

The Handshake AI program is for current students, graduates, and professionals that are interested in working on project-based AI opportunities.

There is no prior experience required to be a part of the Handshake AI program. Certain projects will require specialized subject-matter experts, while other projects have a more generalized focus.

Note: Handshake does not sponsor or facilitate school credit through the Handshake AI Fellowship. This program is open to US-based bachelor’s, master’s, and doctoral students, candidates, and graduates with valid work or training authorization (e.g., F-1/OPT, J-1, H-1B). Participants are responsible for ensuring compliance with their visa conditions and confirming eligibility with their program or visa sponsor prior to signing up.

Pay

Compensation varies by project and depends on factors such as project type, subject expertise, and experience. You’ll always have access to the the project’s hourly rate and any applicable bonus details before joining.

How much time do I need to commit?

The program is designed to be flexible and fit around your existing schedule.

Fellows can contribute based on their availability. Some work a few hours a week, while others contribute more heavily depending on availability and bandwidth. There’s no expectation to be online at specific times or to hit a set number of hours.

A few things to keep in mind:

  • Some projects may set weekly hour caps to help maintain consistency and quality across contributors.
  • Task availability can change quickly, so engaging promptly when work becomes available is the best way to maximize opportunities on a project.
  • Consistent participation matters. Fellows who remain inactive for extended periods while tasks are available may have project access reassigned. Even small but regular contributions help maintain good standing.

Ready to join?

You can sign up for the Handshake AI Fellowship here.

Once signed up you’ll be matched to relevant projects based on your experience and background. Projects are available on a rolling basis.

Additionally, you can check out available opportunities directly on Handshake posted by the Handshake AI Fellowship @ Handshake employer account!

For step-by-step instructions on the application process, refer to Apply for Handshake AI.

Next steps after applying to the Handshake AI Fellowship

Thank you for your interest in becoming a Handshake AI Fellow! We’re excited that you want to help shape the future of AI while continuing to grow your skills and experience.

After submitting your application, your information is now under review by our team for consideration in current and future project opportunities.

What happens after you apply

Our team reviews applications on a rolling basis and matches fellows to projects based on project needs, qualifications, experience, and area of expertise. Because each project is different, timelines for project invitations can vary.

If your background matches the needs of an active or upcoming project, a member of our team will contact you with next steps.

Please note:

  • Submitting an application does not guarantee placement on a project
  • Project invitations are based on current partner demand and project availability
  • Some projects may require additional evaluations, training exercises, or portfolio reviews before selection The Handshake AI Fellowship is designed to support high-quality work for our AI Lab partners, so project selection is competitive and based on overall fit and performance.

Already a Fellow?

If you’ve applied, we’ll reach out if you’re matched with a project. Your profile is also automatically considered for other roles that match your experience, qualifications, and selected domain expertise.

To remain active in the matching process, continue submitting interest forms for opportunities that match your skills and experience through the Opportunities section of your dashboard.

Note: External email links for specific roles will redirect you to your dashboard. This is expected, as these links typically lead to the general Fellowship application, which you have already completed.

What should I do in the meantime?

There’s nothing additional you need to do at this time. If you’re selected for a project, our team will reach out directly by email.

In the meantime, you may find it helpful to:

  • Continue building experience in your area of expertise
  • Familiarize yourself with topics related to AI model evaluation, reasoning, and LLM workflows. To learn more, check out Illustrating Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)
  • Create your own AI projects using AI Showcase in Handshake to continue developing your skills and portfolio. To learn more about this, refer to AI Showcase in Handshake.
  • Monitor your email regularly for project invitations or follow-up communication Projects are added regularly, and new opportunities may become available over time. Not hearing from us right away does not necessarily mean your application has been declined — it may simply mean we do not currently have a project that matches your background.

We truly appreciate the time and effort you put into your application, and we’re excited about the possibility of working with you in the future!

Phone number verification for Handshake AI

To keep Handshake AI a secure and trustworthy platform for fellows and frontier AI labs, phone number verification is required during sign-up for all accounts. This applies to both the web and mobile app.

Phone verification is a standard part of the Handshake AI onboarding process. It helps ensure the integrity of the program by confirming that each account is tied to a real, unique individual. Specifically, it helps us:

  • Prevent fake and duplicate accounts
  • Build a trusted space for HAI fellows

How the verification process works

When creating your Handshake AI account, you’ll be prompted to verify your email address first. After that, you’ll be asked to enter your mobile phone number through our partner Twilio.

You must be able to verify a valid mobile phone number with a supported country code to access Handshake:

  • Standard messaging and data rates may apply.
  • We do not support land-line, VoIP, or toll-free numbers.
  • The country code will be pre-selected based on your location. Not all country codes are supported at this time.
  • If your country code is not listed and you’ve received a project invitation, you’ll need to use the URL from your invitation to sign up. Step 1: Enter your mobile number

Enter a valid mobile phone number when prompted.

The following message will be displayed: “We’ll send a one-time code to your phone. This helps us verify your identity and keep our community safe.”

During this step, you’ll also see two optional SMS preferences you can choose to enable. These are entirely separate from the verification message itself. Your number will not be used for these messages unless you’ve explicitly opted in:

  • Project and task updates (informational messages) If you opt into this, you’ll receive text messages with updates about projects and tasks you’re already active on - things like task availability changes, project status updates, and other time-sensitive information related to your current work.
  • Future project and task opportunities (promotional messages) If you opt into this, you’ll receive text messages about new projects and opportunities you may be eligible for - including project launches, new matches, and relevant program announcements. Note: You can opt into one, both, or neither. Your choices here won’t affect your ability to participate in Handshake AI.

Once entered and opt-in preferences are selected, click Verify with SMS.

Step 2: Receive a verification code

A one-time verification code will be sent to your phone via SMS through our partner Twilio. If you don’t receive it right away, wait a bit because it may be delayed.

Step 3: Enter the code

Type the code into the verification screen to complete the process.

Once verified, your number is securely stored and used only to confirm your identity and prevent misuse. It will not be visible to employers or other users.

Additional information

  • Changing or updating phone number: Phone numbers cannot be edited, even by Handshake admins
  • Accounts created before verification was required: If your account was created before phone verification became mandatory and you’re not affiliated with a school, you’ll be asked to verify your number the next time you log in.

Troubleshooting tips

Didn’t receive a verification code?

Verification code delivery issues are usually caused by rate limiting, carrier filtering, or blocked messages. Try the following:

  • Wait 30 minutes before requesting another code. Requesting multiple codes in a short period can temporarily pause code delivery as a security measure. After 30 minutes, request a new code only once. Keep in mind that codes can arrive late. If a delayed code arrives, it may have already expired, so use the most recent code you receive.
  • Make sure your phone can receive SMS messages from U.S. numbers. Verification codes are sent from a U.S. phone number. Some carriers and prepaid plans block international SMS by default, so confirm that international SMS is enabled with your carrier.
  • Check for blocked numbers or spam filtering.
    • Android: Open the Messages app → tap the three-dot menu → Spam & blocked → unblock any unfamiliar numbers.
    • iPhone: Go to Settings → Apps → Messages → Blocked Contacts, and check your Unknown Senders or Junk messages if applicable.
  • Check your Focus or Do Not Disturb settings. Make sure notifications or messages aren’t being silenced.
  • If you’re in India, verify with your carrier that your phone number is not registered for Do Not Disturb (DND) services, which can block automated messages.
  • Use a standard mobile number. Virtual or VoIP numbers (such as Google Voice or TextNow) often cannot receive verification codes.
  • Perform a few quick device checks. Confirm that you entered the correct phone number and country code, ensure you have cellular service, and try toggling Airplane Mode on and off or restarting your phone.
Entered the code, but it didn’t work?

Verification codes expire after a limited time. If your code has expired, request a new one and enter the most recent code you receive.

Receiving an “Unsupported number” error?

Try registering with a different, valid mobile number–we do not support land-line, VoIP, or toll-free numbers.

Receiving an “unable to use this phone number” error?

This message “We’re unable to use this phone number. If you’ve previously registered, try signing in”? means the phone number is already associated with an existing Handshake account.

  • If you’ve used Handshake before, try signing in to your existing account ai.joinhandshake.com/login.
  • If you don’t recognize the account associated with your phone number, contact Support and provide the phone number so we can investigate.
Phone number already linked to another account?

If you’d like to disconnect your phone number from another account, contact Support to request account deletion and provide the phone number used.

Updating your SMS preferences

If you’d like to change your SMS preferences after completing verification, you can do so at any time through your account settings. You can also reply STOP to any SMS message to opt out of that message type.

For details on managing your notification preferences, refer to Managing Your Notification Preferences.

Resolve Verification or Account Review Issues

If you need help with an identity verification issue, an account under review, or wanting to submit an appeal or request reinstatement, start in the Handshake chatbot.

This also includes trust and safety concerns, such as harassment, a scam, fraud, a fake job posting, or another safety concern.

The chatbot is the fastest way to reach a resolution because it can give you relevant guidance right away and, if a specialist needs to review your case, it collects the right details from the start.

How do I start my report in the chatbot?

  • Open the Handshake chatbot from the Help Center page, or from your dashboard by clicking Support in the top-right corner.
  • Describe your issue.
  • Provide the details the chatbot asks for, such as links, screenshots, names, or dates. These details help route your case correctly.
  • If the chatbot cannot resolve the issue directly, it hands off your conversation to a specialist with your details already included.
    • A ticket is created using the email address on your account by default, so check that email for a ticket confirmation.

How do I get my issue resolved faster?

  • Check your email for confirmation that your ticket was submitted. All follow-up communication about your case happens in that email thread.
    • If you cannot find the confirmation email, check your junk or spam folder. Search for:
      • Subject line: “Support Request Received” (may be sent from Handshake or Handshake AI)
      • Email domain: ai.joinhandshake.com or joinhandshake.com
  • Do not submit more than one ticket for the same issue. If you think of additional details related to your issue, reply to your original ticket email thread so the team can respond without delay.

What happens after a specialist reviews my case?

If your issue needs specialist review, the chatbot hands off your conversation along with the context you already provided, so you do not have to repeat details. A member of the trust and safety team will follow up on next steps.

Why is the chatbot faster than other contact methods?

Starting in the chatbot connects you with the right team from your first message. It reduces back and forth because the chatbot collects the information a specialist needs upfront, instead of waiting for follow-up questions later.

Reporting through other channels, such as email, adds extra steps to route your message to the right team, which slows down resolution.

Troubleshooting Persona identity verification

Persona is the secure identity verification tool used during onboarding for the Handshake AI Fellowship. Most verifications are completed within a few minutes, but occasional issues can come occur. This article covers the most common problems, how to resolve them, and tips to help avoid delays.

Why we use Persona

Identity verification helps us:

  • Confirm that each fellow is who they say they are
  • Protect fellows from fraud or impersonation
  • Meet compliance requirements for paid work Your information is encrypted, secure, and used only for verification purposes.

Device requirements (important)

Persona verification must be completed on a smartphone or tablet with a working camera.

Why this matters

Some verification steps rely on mobile camera features that are not fully supported on laptops or desktop computers. Because of this, computer-only verification attempts may fail.

What to do if you only have a laptop
  • Use a smartphone or tablet to complete verification
  • Use a trusted personal device
  • After verification is complete, you can return to your laptop to continue onboarding If you attempt to complete Persona using only a laptop or desktop computer, you may not be able to finish the verification process.

Before you start: Tips for a smoother verification

To reduce the chance of delays or failed verification attempts:

  • Use a strong Wi-Fi or mobile data connection
  • Fully charge your device before starting
  • Clean your camera lens before taking photos
  • Use your legal name exactly as it appears on your ID
  • Make sure your Handshake AI profile information matches your identification documents
  • Avoid using screenshots, photocopies, or edited images of IDs
  • Complete the process in one sitting if possible

Common issues and how to fix them

1. ID photo is rejected

Common reasons

  • Blurry or dark image

  • Glare on the ID

  • Cropped edges or missing information

  • Expired ID

  • Using unsupported ID types What to do

  • Take the photo in a well-lit room

  • Place your ID on a solid background

  • Make sure all four corners are visible

  • Hold the camera steady until the image is captured

  • Ensure the text and barcode are clear and readable

  • Make sure the correct country is selected for your ID type

  • Ensure the ID type shown matches what you selected during verification

  • Use a valid, government-issued ID (such as a driver’s license or national ID card) from the accepted ID Additional tips

  • Avoid noisy or cluttered backgrounds

  • Avoid using flash directly on glossy IDs

  • Make sure text and your photo appear sharp and readable

  • If your camera struggles to focus, move slightly farther away and zoom in gradually

  • For additional support, visit Persona’s help page

2. Selfie or face scan fails

Common reasons

  • Poor lighting

  • Face partially out of frame

  • Wearing hats, masks, or sunglasses

  • Camera movement during capture What to do

  • Face a light source directly

  • Remove hats, glasses, masks, or any face coverings

  • Hold the camera steady and follow on-screen instructions carefully

  • Position your entire face within the frame

3. Persona won’t load or gets stuck

What you might experience

  • A blank screen

  • A loading spinner that never finishes

  • The page closes unexpectedly

  • Verification freezes during upload What to do

  • Refresh the page and try again

  • Open the link in the latest version of Google Chrome or Safari

  • Disable ad blockers or privacy extensions

  • If you’re on a work or school network, try switching to a personal Wi-Fi or mobile hotspot Additional tips

  • Avoid opening multiple Persona tabs at once

  • Close other apps using your camera before retrying

  • Restart your device if uploads repeatedly fail

4. Camera or microphone access is blocked

What you might experience

  • A message saying camera access is denied

  • The photo or video step won’t start What to do

  • Allow camera permissions when prompted by your browser

  • Check browser settings and confirm camera access is enabled

  • On mobile devices, confirm camera permissions are enabled in your phone settings

  • Restart the browser after updating permissions if needed Additional tips

  • Some privacy-focused browsers may block camera access by default

  • If issues continue, try using Chrome if you’re not already instead of third-party browsers

5. Verification is taking longer than expected

Most Persona verifications are completed within minutes, but some reviews may take longer if:

  • Images require manual review

  • There is a mismatch between submitted information and documents

  • Additional verification checks are needed What to know

  • A longer review does not mean your application was rejected

  • You do not need to resubmit unless specifically prompted

  • Duplicate submissions can sometimes delay processing further Important: Verification reviews may take up to 2 weeks to complete. During this time, there is no need to contact support or submit additional tickets. If you’ve already reached out, please wait for a response as submitting multiple tickets may delay the review process.

6. You accidentally exited Persona

You can safely restart the process at any time.

  • Return to your Handshake AI dashboard
  • Click the Persona verification step again
  • Restart and complete the flow from the beginning

What not to do

To avoid delays or account issues:

  • Do not create multiple Handshake AI accounts
  • Do not submit someone else’s ID
  • Do not use edited, scanned, or photocopied identification documents
  • Do not attempt to bypass verification steps
  • Do not repeatedly resubmit verification attempts unless instructed These actions may delay onboarding or result in account restrictions.

Understanding the Background Check Process

Some Handshake AI customers require background checks as part of their security and compliance processes. If you’re assigned to work on a project with one of these customers, you’ll be asked to complete a background check (BGC) before you can begin.

Your background check is completed through three connected systems: the Handshake AI platform, Persona, and Yardstik. Handshake AI initiates the process, Persona securely collects and verifies your identity information, and Yardstik performs the background screening. These systems work together to provide a secure and streamlined experience.

Note: Fellows outside the United States will complete their background check through Checkr instead of Yardstik.

This guide explains how the background check process works for fellows in the United States and what you can expect during the process. Keep in mind that the exact screens and interface may change over time as Persona and Yardstik update their products, but the overall process remains the same.

To learn more about background checks on Handshake, refer to Background Check FAQs.

How the Process Works

  1. From your dashboard, open the project you’ve been invited to and click Verify.

  2. Click Begin Verifying to start the verification process.

  3. Enter your email address in the provided space. This is used for correspondence about your background check, then click Continue.

  4. Enter your information. You’ll be asked to provide the information required to complete your background check, including:

  • Full legal name
  • Date of birth
  • Social Security Number (SSN)
  • Current address
  1. Review and sign the required disclosures. Carefully review each and provide your consent where required. You’ll complete the following steps:
  • Background Check Disclosure
  • State and Local Law Notices and Disclosures
    • Note: Because Handshake is based in California, all contributors must review and acknowledge the California Background Investigation Disclosure.
  • Acknowledgment and Authorization for Background Check
  • Summary of Rights Acknowledgment
  • Privacy Policy Agreement
  1. After you’ve completed all required acknowledgments and signatures, click Done.

You’ll be returned to your dashboard, where your background check will be marked as Complete and submitted for review.

What Happens Next

Your background check is reviewed. Background check results are typically available within 7 days, although some checks may take longer depending on the information that needs to be verified.

You can continue onboarding for the project while the background check is pending. You don’t need to wait for your background check to finish before continuing project onboarding.

If your background check is approved

No further action is required. Once your background check meets the project’s requirements, you’ll be able to continue tasking.

If additional review is needed

If your background check does not meet the project’s requirements, you’ll receive a Pre-Adverse Action Notice from Yardstik. This notice gives you a minimum of 7 days to:

  • Review your background check report
  • Dispute any inaccurate information
  • Provide additional information before a final decision is made If you need to dispute information in your report, refer to Yardstik’s Help Center article How can I dispute the results of my report?

Getting Started in Handshake

About Handshake Mobile for iOS and Android

The Handshake mobile app lets you access Handshake anytime, anywhere, bringing many of the same features from the web experience to your phone.

Download and log in

The Handshake app is free to download and use on iOS and Android devices.

To download and sign in:

  • Install the Handshake app from the App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android).
  • Follow the steps in How to Log into Handshake Mobile to log in with your Handshake email.

What you can do on mobile

The Handshake app gives you convenient access to many of the features you use on the web:

  • Discover opportunities: Browse and search for jobs, events, and career fairs directly from your phone.
  • Apply for jobs: View job details and submit applications through the app.
  • Appointments with your career center: Request and manage appointments with your career center. For step-by-step appointment instructions, refer to Request an Appointment with your Career Center.
  • Messages: Open your Inbox to read, send, and respond to messages from employers, peers, alumni, and career services staff. Learn more in How to Use Messages in Handshake.
  • Profile and activity: Update your profile so employers, peers, and career centers have your latest information. Track how often your profile is viewed and explore engagement trends. Learn more in Profile Insights: Track Views and Engagement.
  • Event and fair check-in: Use your phone to check in quickly at events and fairs by scanning the organizer’s QR code while logged into Handshake. For more detail, refer to Check-in with an Employer at an Event or Fair.
  • Handshake Feed: Browse the feed to discover posts from fellow students, employers, and your career center. You can also create your own posts—using text, images, or video—directly from the mobile app via the Feed tab. For more information on posting to the feed, check out Posting Content to the Handshake Feed.

Global Search (iOS Only)

On iOS, the Handshake app includes a Global Search experience that lets you search across multiple categories in one place.

  • Access: Open the Search tab in the app.
  • Before you type: Review your Recent searches or suggested keywords.
  • As you type: Tap See all results to expand results and optionally filter by category:
    • Jobs
    • People
    • Events
    • Employers Results are ranked within each category, not mixed across categories.

Note: Content from the Feed is not included in Global Search results.

About the Filter “Not Labels”

Not Labels in Handshake allow filtering to only records that do not have the selected label applied.

The following example provides instructions to filtering using Not Labels.

  • Click Students using the left-hand navigation panel. This will take you to the Manage students page.

  • Click Not Labels and select a label on which you’d like to filter. We’ll be using honor student in this example.

  • This will populate all students that do not have the label honor student attached to their Handshake account.In the picture below, students that do not have the honor student label are displayed: You will find Not Label filters on the following pages:

  • Manage students

  • Contacts

  • Experiences

  • Outcomes

  • Applications

  • Events

  • Jobs (listed as “exclude employer labels”)

  • Employers To learn more about creating labels, please refer to School Settings: Labels

To learn more about searching using labels, please refer to How to Search Using Labels

Calendar Sync Options in Handshake

Handshake offers several ways to communicate the events and Appointments over to your University Calendar. This article will explain each option and detail how they can assist you with your tasks.

  • Two Way Calendar Sync
  • Personal Handshake Calendar Sync
  • School Handshake Calendar Sync

Two Way Calendar Sync (recommended)

This option will allow your University Calendar and Handshake Appointments Calendar determine when you have scheduled items and when you are busy with other tasks:

  • Handshake will place all scheduled Appointments on your University Calendar
  • Your University Calendar will place all “busy” Appointments into your Handshake Appointment Calendar. This will be displayed as a grey striped block of time that cannot be scheduled by Students. Learn how to set up the Two-Way sync in Career Services User Settings: Two-Way Calendar Sync.

You can also copy your events and appointments from Handshake over to your University Calendar without the Two Way Sync.

Follow the instructions below to sync your Handshake calendar with your Outlook or Google Calendar.

Please note that the calendar export URL for your personal Handshake calendar (found in your user settings) looks exactly the same as the one for your school’s Handshake calendar (found in your school settings), but are different, as shown below.

Personal Handshake Calendar Sync

This will export to your external personal calendar and will include:

  • Appointments

  • Events

  • Interview slots (students only)

  • Applications (students only) To set this up:

  • Click the main drop down menu

  • Select User Settings

  • Click Calendar Sync from the menu to the left of the page

  • Copy the link in the Calendar Export section or download a static iCalendar file Note: The static file download link isn’t updated automatically.

School Handshake Calendar Sync

This will export to your external personal calendar and will include:

  • Hosted events

  • Owned events

  • Attending events

  • Career Fairs To set this up:

  • Click the main drop down menu

  • Select School Settings

  • Copy the link in the Calendar Export section or download a static iCalendar file Note: The static file download link isn’t updated automatically.

Calendar Specific Instructions

Once you have your Calendar Export link, you will need to add it to your Calendar. There are many Calendar apps out there, with some that are included built into your Operating System.

We have included links to instructions for some of the most popular calendar applications below. You may need to refer to the instruction manual for your Calendar application to locate where to add an ICS URL if you don’t use one of the calendars below.

  • Outlook Calendar
  • Google Calendar*
  • Office 365 Calendar Note: It may take up to 12 hours to see updates to your Google Calendar from Handshake. This is a Google setting and Handshake can not modify this setting.
